Name: Vampiric Buildings
Author: JackR0
Description:
[b][color=#a61c00]Vampiric Buildings by Jack Rivers[/color]

[/b]I started this as a personal project and got really excited when I figured out the .json files (with the help of the AT wiki/github!)

If you notice anything wonky with the textures (or find any errors) or have any ideas for improvements, let me know!

[b]Note:[/b] While testing the CP version of this, I noticed a visual glitch where there are lines through the farmhouse and weird textures on the windows. I basically 50/50'd all my mods and noticed it [b]might[/b] be specific to my save. If it's not, and you know what the issue is, [b]please[/b] do not hesitate to make a post/bug report on here <

[b][color=#a61c00]---------------------------------------[/color][/b]

[b]Installation

[list=1]
[*]SMAPI - and requirements
[/list][/b] ﻿ Make sure SMAPI (Stardew Modding API) and AT (Alternative Textures)/CP (Content Patcher) are downloaded and up to date!

﻿[b]2. Vampiric Buildings[/b]
﻿ Install this mod! (AT version [b]or[/b] CP version)

﻿[b]3.[/b] [b]Mod Folder[/b]
﻿ Unzip Vampiric Buildings and place it into your mods folder! (It can be in a subfolder if you like to keep things organized.)
